CustomField.description: Set when TeamsSwarmChatDeleteQueueable fails to delete the Teams chat after End Chat saved the transcript (most often missing Chat.ManageDeletion.All consent on the MS_Graph app registration). The transcript and the Case reset still succeeded - this only means the chat is still present in Microsoft Teams and needs deleting by hand. Cleared on the next successful delete.
CustomField.label: Swarm Chat Delete Error
